mapper.select: select c.stock_code as "stockCode", c.stock_name as "stockName", c.snapshot->>'market' as market, r.actual_trade_date as "tradeDate", (c.snapshot->>'price')::numeric as "entryPrice" from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_candidate c join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_run r on r.id=c.strategy_run_id where c.id=#{candidateId} and r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and r.owner_id=#{ownerId} and r.deleted_at is null

select item.*, list.name as watchlist_name from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_watchlist_item item join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_watchlist list on list.id=item.watchlist_id where item.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and item.owner_id=#{ownerId} and item.watchlist_id=#{watchlistId} and item.stock_code=#{stockCode} and item.deleted_at is null and item.status in ('WATCHING','PAUSED') limit 1

select id,name,version from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_watchlist where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and lower(name)=lower(#{name}) and status='ACTIVE' and deleted_at is null limit 1

select item.*, list.name as watchlist_name from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_watchlist_item item join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_watchlist list on list.id=item.watchlist_id where item.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and item.owner_id=#{ownerId} and item.deleted_at is null order by list.name asc,item.updated_at desc

select id,watchlist_item_id,tenant_id,owner_id,decision,note,reviewed_at from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_watchlist_review where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} order by reviewed_at desc
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_watchlist_item set status=#{status},version=#{version},updated_at=#{updatedAt} where id=#{id} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and version=#{expectedVersion} and deleted_at is null
